hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.subtitle: By accessing or using Busaty you agree to the legal terms below, updated as required.

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.body: "Service" refers to the Busaty platform and apps. "User" covers guardians, attendants, drivers, and school representatives who create an account or access the service.

sections.heading: 2. User obligations
sections.body: Users must provide accurate information, keep credentials confidential, comply with applicable laws, and refrain from misusing the service.

sections.heading: 3. Data privacy
sections.body: We protect student and guardian data under our privacy policy and only share it with third parties when required by law or with explicit consent.

sections.heading: 4. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Busaty is not liable for damages caused by misuse or events beyond our control, while we commit to reasonable care and timely support.

sections.heading: 5. Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time; the revised version and last-updated date will be posted, and continued use constitutes acceptance.
